gold_note: Dinosauromorph cladogram, read from the full image and crops. Ten clade names are kept as internal labels: Dinosauromorpha, Dinosauriformes, Dinosauria and Saurischia (arrows to the stems below their nodes), and Lagerpetidae, Silesauridae, Ornithischia, Herrerasauridae, Theropoda and Sauropodomorpha (coloured bands, each spanning one clade). Polytomies: five silesaurids, five theropods (stem entering at Panguraptor's height), a four-way saurischian node (Agnosphitys, Eodromaeus, Daemonosaurus and the rest) and a fifteen-way sauropodomorph node. 83 tips, 4 polytomies (5, 4, 5, 15 children); 10 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
